summary: A mixed morning dominated by retail sector moves and Reliance's capital market activity. Godrej family acquires 1% stake in Godrej Consumer for ₹900 crore while packaged health foods surge 60% in two months; separately, Reliance plans up to $1 billion in local currency bonds—its second bond sale in three weeks.

bullets.text: Four Godrej family members acquired 1% stake in Godrej Consumer Products for ₹900 crore at ₹880 per share (1.02 crore shares).
Sales of packaged health foods with transparent clean ingredient claims surged 60% in two months.
Reliance plans up to $1 billion in local currency bonds, its second bond sale in three weeks.
ESDS Software Solution Q1 FY27 net profit fell 57% sequentially to ₹29.3 crore; shares hit 5% lower circuit at ₹1,758.
Welspun Corp's US subsidiary secured $412.5 million HFIW pipe order, lifting global order book to $4.7 billion.
